about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

The decorations are set, the music is on, and the snacks and drinks have been served. But when a mysterious, magical culprit snatches the birthday cake and vanishes through a portal, it's time to go full dungeon crawler. The party is over… or has it just begun?

A PARTY OF HEROES

Play as one of four classic archetypes, each with their own unique playstyle inspired by Dungeons & Dragons. Whether you prefer tanking for the party as Carrots (Paladin), dishing out splash damage as Squeaky (Sorcerer), throwing hands as "The Business" (Monk), or rock-chucking from afar as Big Samantha (Ranger), there’s a hero for every adventurer.

DUNGEON CRAWL, PARTY STYLE

Fight your way through varied realms, each with deadly enemies, environmental hazards, and bosses who take their cake stealing very seriously. Master action combat with quick combos, charged attacks, dodges, and parries (depending on your class), and unlock new abilities as you level up your hero.

Plus, find optional collectibles, exciting secrets, and shiny loot. It’s a birthday party after all.

PLAY TOGETHER (OR PERISH TOGETHER)

The Birthday Boys is designed for four-player online co-op, but you can also dive in solo if you’re feeling brave. Combine your unique class abilities to control crowds, deal big damage, and keep each other alive when things get dicey. Or don’t, and just let your friends do all the work. 

A MYSTERIOUS CAKE THIEF

Who would steal a birthday cake? Who is this portal-jumping pastry pilferer? Is he acting alone? If he can summon portals, what else can he do?

You’ll discover the answers as you battle across realms, face off against formidable bosses, and unravel the mystery one slice at a time. Your mission: get the cake back and save the party.

COMING SOON—ADD TO YOUR STEAM WISHLIST TODAY

It doesn’t have to be your birthday to make a wish. Save your spot at the party by wishlisting The Birthday Boys on Steam, so you’re ready when the cake (and chaos) arrives.

  • DirectX: Version 11
